mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, machine_part_scheduling_id, nest_cut_plate_id, length, mac, material, nc_name, nc_code, nc_url, oss_key, plate_no, allocate_time, send_time, source, thick, cut_instruction_id, num, width, weight, bool_have_surplus, pdf_name, pdf_url
mapper.select: SELECT cut_plate.*, gro.id 'groups.id', gro.NAME 'groups.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.NAME 'workshop.name', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.NAME 'production_line.name', cut_config.`name` cut_name FROM mes_building_nest_cut_plate cut_plate LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups gro ON gro.id = cut_plate.groups_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = gro.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = gro.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_machine_part_scheduling scheduling ON scheduling.id = cut_plate.machine_part_scheduling_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cut_config cut_config ON cut_config.id = scheduling.cut_config_id WHERE cut_plate.machine_part_scheduling_id =#{id}
